title: CFA Level I — demo set (illustrative only)

questions.stem: Which standard most directly requires placing client interests ahead of personal interests?
questions.explanation: Duty to clients includes acting with loyalty, prudence, and care—typically framed as placing client interests first. Always confirm wording with the current CFA Institute Code and Standards.

questions.stem: If annual compounding applies, the future value of a lump sum increases when which of the following increases?
choices: Time horizon or stated interest rate
Number of periods only, with rate held constant at zero
questions.explanation: Future value grows with a higher interest rate and/or more compounding periods (longer horizon), other things equal.

questions.stem: Which statement is true about the balance sheet?
choices: It summarizes performance over a period
It presents assets, liabilities, and equity at a point in time
It is identical to the statement of cash flows
questions.explanation: The balance sheet is a snapshot at a specific date: assets = liabilities + equity.

questions.stem: The weighted average cost of capital (WACC) is generally used to:
choices: Discount expected future cash flows in a firm valuation context
Replace the risk-free rate in all models
questions.explanation: WACC is a common hurdle or discount rate reflecting blended costs of debt and equity financing.

questions.stem: In a competitive market with rational investors, prices most often reflect:
choices: Public information in semi-strong form efficiency
Fixed par value regardless of news
questions.explanation: Semi-strong efficiency implies prices reflect all publicly available information.

questions.stem: When market yields rise, the price of an option-free conventional bond typically:
questions.explanation: Bond prices and yields move inversely for fixed cash flows.

questions.stem: A forward contract differs from a futures contract primarily in that forwards are often:
questions.explanation: Forwards are typically bilateral OTC contracts with terms customized between parties.

questions.stem: Diversification across uncorrelated assets primarily aims to:
questions.explanation: Diversification reduces asset-specific risk; market risk remains.
